project.name: Brightpath Academy
project.description: An online course platform where instructors publish self-paced courses and learners enroll, progress through ordered lessons and quizzes, and review finished courses.

app.name: Brightpath Academy
app.tagline: Self-paced online course platform for curious minds

help.summary: A concise overview of the course subject and learning goals

looks.reason: Clean, calm, and distraction-free styling gives learners and instructors focus with ample whitespace.
Editorial feel with bookish type suits rigorous courses, written lessons, and studious academy themes.
Rounded friendly aesthetic creates an approachable, modern self-paced digital learning platform.

requested.words: calm and studious, plenty of white space, a deep teal accent

replaced: Enrollment: side needs an image, a video or an audio field; shown as stacked
LessonProgress: title 'lessonId' left out (a uuid field is not a name)
area 'learners': Enrollment: side needs an image, a video or an audio field; shown as stacked
area 'learners': LessonProgress: title 'lessonId' left out (a uuid field is not a name)

tours.name: Course Learning and Completion
tours.outcome: Learner successfully completes all lessons in order and finishes the course.

steps.title: Browse catalogue by category and select course. Rule: Course must be published
Enroll in the selected course (the enrollment becomes active). Rule: Learner cannot already be actively enrolled
Open current lesson where left off (the enrollment becomes active). Rule: Must follow lesson order
Take quiz at the end of the lesson if present (the quiz_submission becomes passed). Rule: Quiz questions must all be answered
Mark lesson as complete (the lesson_progress becomes completed). Rule: Previous lessons and required quiz must be completed
Complete the final lesson and complete course (the enrollment becomes completed). Rule: All lessons in the course must be completed

tours.name: Course Authoring and Publishing
tours.outcome: A structured course with ordered lessons is published to the catalogue.

steps.title: Create course draft under a category (the course becomes draft). Rule: Category must exist
Add ordered video or text lessons to course (the lesson becomes draft). Rule: Lessons must have a defined sequence order
Attach short quiz to lesson (the quiz becomes draft). Rule: Quiz must belong to a lesson
Publish the complete course (the course becomes published). Rule: Course must contain at least one lesson

tours.name: Course Rating and Reviewing
tours.outcome: A public rating and review are posted for a completed course.

steps.title: Submit star rating and short review for finished course (the review becomes published). Rule: Learner must have completed the course
